JiuwenSwarm 可选块** | Skill 包管理、Skill Hub、jiuwenbox、cron 调度、A2UI、内置 Skill | **可选依赖，每块一个 port，rev pin** | | **L2 本项目自有** | 科学 rails/tools/explore、科学域服务、科学侧车、runner、产品控制面、Web | 自有 | > **铁律：本项目业务代码不得直接 `import jiuwenswarm`。每块 JiuwenSwarm 能力先定义一个 `Protocol`（port），再在 `adapters/swarm/` 下写适配器实现。** 理由：JiuwenSwarm 是产品不是 SDK（包名 `workswarm`，版本 `0.2.5.beta1`，无公开 API 声明）。把 import 点收敛到一个目录，漂移的爆炸半径就是那个目录；每块可以独立决策、独立回滚；agent-core 保持独立可见。 ### 3.2 进程拓扑 ```mermaid flowchart TB UI["apps/web（React，不变）"] UI -->|"REST + SSE，37 类事件"| API subgraph API["sd-api（Node，:4310，保留）"] A1["http/ · store.ts · 静态托管"] A2["设置 / 模型 / 用量 / MCP 治理 / 权限 / 插件"] A3["agent-client（新增）：驱动 sd-agent"] A4["internal（新增）：科学域服务路由"] end subgraph AGENT["sd-agent（Python，新增）"] L0["L0：import openjiuwen
create_deep_agent · ContextEngine · AgentRail
agent_teams · swarmflow seam"] L2["L2：科学 rails / tools / explore"] L1["L1：ports ← adapters/swarm ⁄ adapters/native"] end API -->|"窄契约：环回 NDJSON + 内部 token"| AGENT subgraph SVC["科学域服务"] R["sd-runner :4311（micromamba · NPU · SSH · kernel）"] E["evolve / memory-graph / paper"] end API -->|"环回 HTTP + token"| SVC AGENT -->|"环回 HTTP + token"| SVC AGENT -.->|"可选，本机 HTTP"| BOX["jiuwenbox"] ``` 四条边界：前端与 `sd-api` 的 REST/SSE 契约**不变**；`sd-api` 与 `sd-agent` 之间用**本项目自定义的窄契约**（不实现 JiuwenSwarm 的 148 个 `ReqMethod`）；科学域服务沿用现有的环回 + 内部 token；JiuwenSwarm 的接触面只有 `adapters/swarm/`。 --- ## 四、代码结构与迁移映射 ### 4.1 新增 `services/agent/` ``` services/agent/ ├── pyproject.toml │ dependencies = [ "openjiuwen==" ] ← L0 硬依赖 │ optional-dependencies: │ swarm-skill / swarm-hub = [ "workswarm==" ] ← L1 按块可选 ├── scripts/check_layers.py ← 分层护栏 └── src/sciencediscovery_agent/ ├── runtime/ ═ L0：只 import openjiuwen ═ │ assembly.py（DeepAgentConfig → create_deep_agent） │ session.py · events.py（→ 37 类 SSE）· model.py · permissions.py ├── context/ ═ L0：上下文三语义 ═ │ processors.py（register_processor） │ window.py（register_window_mutator） │ projections.py（active_skills / plan_state / trust 标注） ├── science/ ═ L2：只依赖 ports/ ═ │ rails/（证据门禁 · 评审检查点 · 溯源记录） │ tools/（执行 · 证据 · 图谱 · 论文） │ explore/（Provider 实现：PUCT / idea-tree） ├── ports/ ═ L1 抽象：纯 Protocol，零依赖 ═ │ skill_store · skill_hub · sandbox · session_store · scheduler ├── adapters/ │ native/ ═ 兜底实现，不依赖 JiuwenSwarm ═ │ swarm/ ═ ★ 唯一允许 import jiuwenswarm ═ └── transport/ ═ 与 sd-api 的窄契约 ═ ``` `check_layers.py` 六条断言进 CI： 1. `runtime/` `context/` `science/` 不得出现 `import jiuwenswarm` 2. `ports/` 不得 import `openjiuwen` 与 `jiuwenswarm`（纯 Protocol） 3. `adapters/native/` 不得 import `jiuwenswarm` 4. `adapters/swarm/` 是唯一允许的目录 5. **每个 `adapters/swarm/.py` 必须有同名的 `adapters/native/.py` 兜底** 6. `science/` 不得 import `adapters/` 第 5 条是关键：没有兜底，「可选」就是假的。 ### 4.2 迁移映射 | 现有 | 行数 | 去向 | 替代者 | |---|---:|---|---| | `packages/runtime-core` | 626 | ❌ 删 | L0 `core/single_agent` + `core/runner` | | `packages/context` | 2,439 | ❌ 删，语义迁 `sd-agent/context/` | L0 `core/context_engine` 23,999 | | `packages/model` | 1,465 | ❌ 删 | L0 `core/foundation/llm` | | `packages/tools` + `workspace`（工具部分） | 约 3,400 | ❌ 删 | L0 `harness/tools` 47,454 | | `packages/specialist` + `orchestration` + `plan` | 3,190 | ❌ 删 | L0 `agent_teams` + `harness/rails` | | `packages/governance` | 227 | ◐ 策略留 Node，审批迁 `sd-agent` | L0 `harness/security` | | `packages/provenance` `idea-tree` `memory` `cas` `artifact-manager` `data-source` `trajectory` | 13,675 | ◐ 加 HTTP 外壳成为 `internal/` 域服务 | — | | `packages/schema` `mcp` `mcp-sources` `skill` `plugin-sdk` `executor` `sandbox-capability` | 约 13,000 | ✅ 保留 Node | — | | `services/api/native-agent` | 1,121 | ❌ 删 | — | | `services/api/{runs,agent-run,bootstrap}` | 5,112 | ◐ 改写为 `sd-agent` 客户端 | — | | `services/api` 其余 | 约 25,000 | ✅ 保留 | — | | `services/runner` | 8,798 | ✅ 保留（M2 可选把隔离原语换成 jiuwenbox） | — | | `services/{evolve,memory-graph,paper,gateway}` | 23,045 | ✅ 保留 | — | | `skills/` 17 个 | 3,641 | ✅ 保留，经 `ports/skill_store` 读取 | — | | `services/launcher` + `scripts/binary-release` | 3,203+ | ◐ payload 增 Python 运行时 | — | | **新增** `services/agent/` | 约 8,000–13,000 | ➕ | — | | **新增** `services/api/src/{agent-client,internal}` | 约 3,500–6,000 | ➕ | — | **后端非测试 TypeScript 82,367 行中，保留约 66,400 行（约 81%）。** --- ## 五、改基础算法的路径（这些缝全部在 agent-core） ### 5.1 上下文组装 `openjiuwen/core/context_engine/` 是完整插件架构：`ModelContext(ABC)`（抽象方法含 `get_context_window()`）、`ContextProcessor`（钩子 `on_add_messages` / `on_get_context_window`）、6 个内置压缩器 + 4 个卸载器。四个改造层级，均**零源码改动**： | 层级 | API | 能改什么 | |---|---|---| | L1 注入 | `AgentRail.before_model_call(ctx)` 改 `ModelCallInputs` | 加删消息、加 prompt section | | L2 换处理器 | `@ContextEngine.register_processor` | 压缩 / 召回 / 卸载算法本身 | | L3 换最终窗口 | `agent.context_engine.register_window_mutator(fn)`，`fn: (ModelContext, ContextWindow) -> Awaitable[ContextWindow]` | **最终送进推理的窗口** | | L4 换整个模型 | 实现 `ModelContext(ABC)` 子类 | 整个上下文语义 | L3 正好承接我们现有 `packages/context` 的「model-aware 原子窗口选择 + 最终校验」。**待验证**：`register_window_mutator` 的执行点是否确实在所有 processor 之后。 ### 5.2 多 agent 探索 `openjiuwen/agent_teams/workflow/engine/seam.py` 文件头原文： > "The provider seam: the indirection that lets the engine be swapped. … The engine installs its `EngineProvider` for the duration of a run; **a different implementation … can install its own provider instead, and workflow scripts never change**." API：`Provider(Protocol)` 覆盖 `agent()` / `parallel()` / `pipeline()` / `map_parallel()` / `agent_session()` / `human()` / `budget`，配 `use_provider(p) -> Token` / `reset_provider()`。因为存在 `contextvar` 里，**科学探索 run 与普通 run 可在同进程并存**。 于是把 `services/evolve` 的 PUCT 搜索或 `packages/idea-tree` 的想法树升级成多 agent 分支探索，做法是实现一个 `ScienceExploreProvider` 装上去，**workflow 脚本一行不改**。 另有按名覆盖：`register_subagent_provider(name, factory)` 的文档写明「a later registration for the same name overrides it」，内置探索子智能体名为 `core.explore_agent`。 ⚠️ 注意两张表语义相反：`harness/manifest/catalog.py` 的 `add_descriptor()`（元数据）**拒绝重名并抛 `ValueError`**；provider 注册表（工厂）**后注册覆盖**。要覆盖内置算法走 provider 注册表，不要重复同名的 `@harness_element` 声明。 --- ## 六、侵入分析 侵入要分三种： - **A 型（源码侵入）**：必须改 JiuwenSwarm 的文件 - **B 型（协商性侵入）**：不改今天的行为，但要求冻结或新增扩展点 - **C 型（反向侵入）**：不改 JiuwenSwarm 一行，但**它的运行期假设侵入我们**——改进程状态、强制数据目录布局、注入依赖树 前两种此前讨论过，**C 型是这轮新发现的，也是「按块复用」的真正门槛**。 ### 6.1 C 型：三个全局副作用源 **(1) `jiuwenswarm/common/config.py` 在导入期修改 `sys.path`**（第 48–57 行）： ```python _user_config = os.getenv("JIUWENSWARM_CONFIG_DIR") if _user_config: _CONFIG_MODULE_DIR = Path(_user_config) elif get_config_dir().exists(): _CONFIG_MODULE_DIR = get_config_dir() if str(_CONFIG_MODULE_DIR) not in sys.path: sys.path.insert(0, str(_CONFIG_MODULE_DIR)) # 插到最前 ``` 进程级、导入即生效、不可撤销。若该目录含同名 `.py` 会**静默 shadow** 我们的模块；且行为取决于环境变量与目录是否存在，同一份代码在不同机器上 `sys.path` 不同。`get_config` 被 185 个文件使用。 **(2) `common/utils.py`（2,954 行）假定 `~/.jiuwenswarm` 工作区布局**：解析顺序 `JIUWENSWARM_DATA_DIR` → `JIUWENSWARM_HOME` → `~/.jiuwenswarm`，并期望其下有 `config/config.yaml`、`agent/workspace/` 等结构。我们若 import 依赖它的块，就必须在自己的数据目录下再造一个最小 JiuwenSwarm 工作区。 **(3) 依赖树注入**：`workswarm` 的 `dependencies` 含 `chromadb`、`faiss-cpu`、`playwright`、`tree-sitter`、`sqlite-vec`、`pgvector`、`opentelemetry-*`，以及对本项目完全无用的 `python-telegram-bot` / `discord.py` / `slack-bolt` / `dingtalk-stream` / `wecom-aibot-sdk`。 ### 6.2 C 型按块实测 | 块 | 依赖 `common.config` | 依赖 `common.utils` | `sys.path` 副作用 | **C 型等级** | |---|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:| | **Skill Hub**（`marketplace/hub_client` + 3 个兄弟文件） | **0** | **0** | **无** | **无** | | **Skill 文件/归档原语**（`skill_files` `archive_store`） | 0 | 0 | 无 | **无** | | **jiuwenbox** | 0 | 0 | 无（本机 HTTP 服务） | **无** | | cron store | 0 | 1（一个路径函数） | 无 | **低** | | **Skill 包管理**（`skill_manager.py` 8,841 行） | **4** | 1 | **有** | **高** | | 会话存储 / 项目 Git | 多 | 多 | 有 | **高**（且与我们的 `catalog.sqlite` 双主） | | 产品 rails / tools | 多 | 多 | 有 | **高** | 由此修订接入策略： - **Skill Hub**：四个文件干净到可以直接 import，也可以照抄（Apache-2.0）。零 C 型侵入。 - **jiuwenbox**：**它已经是独立组件**——自带 `pyproject.toml`（`name = "jiuwenbox"`），依赖只有 pydantic/pyyaml/httpx/fastapi/uvicorn/python-multipart/mcp，**不依赖 `workswarm`**，Python 代码对 `jiuwenswarm` 零引用；JiuwenSwarm 自己也是通过 HTTP 调它。我们可以 `pip install "jiuwenbox @ git+#subdirectory=jiuwenbox"`，零侵入。 - **cron**：只要一个路径函数。建议照抄 cron 表达式与 store 语义到 `adapters/native/`，不为一个函数引入 `common.utils`。 - **Skill 包管理**：8,841 行会带来全套 C 型侵入。三个选择：① 在 `sd-agent` 独立进程里接受它；② 只取 `skill_files` + `archive_store` 两个干净原语，打包逻辑自己写；③ 不接。 - **会话存储**：明确不接，避免与我们的 `catalog.sqlite` 形成双主；会话回溯用 L0 的 `core/session/vcs` 底座自己做产品化。 **新增设计约束**：`adapters/swarm/` 每个适配器要在文件头声明它拖进来的 C 型侵入，由 `check_layers.py` 校验声明与实际 import 一致；未声明的 import 直接失败。 ### 6.3 A 型：必须改 JiuwenSwarm 源码的场景，已缩到 2 条 本方案下**不再适用**的四条：新增 `ReqMethod`（我们不跑 AgentServer）、改 `agent_adapter`（我们自己装配）、换协作调度内核（走 agent-core 的 seam）、复用 JiuwenSwarm 前端组件（前端用我们自己的）。 仍然适用的： | # | 场景 | 触发条件 | 处置 | |---|---|---|---| | **A1** | jiuwenbox 增加 macOS 隔离后端 | 要保住 macOS 源码模式**同时**采用 jiuwenbox（jiuwenbox 目前 Linux-only；我们的 `seatbelt.ts` 在 47 个文件被引用） | 上游 PR；或不采用 jiuwenbox，继续用 `services/runner` | | **A2** | `skill_manager` 解耦工作区与全局 config | 要接 Skill 包管理，且不接受 6.1 的 C 型侵入 | 上游 PR（改为构造参数注入）；短期用 6.2 的选择② | 另有 A3（`common/config.py` 去掉导入期 `sys.path` 变更）只在「后端完全合并为单一 Python 进程」的形态下出现；本方案的 Node + sidecar 形态天然规避。 ### 6.4 B 型：建议向上游提出的扩展点 | # | 对象 | 诉求 | 不给的代价 | |---|---|---|---| | B1 | **agent-core** | 明确 `register_{rail,tool,subagent}_provider` 与 `ContextEngine.register_processor` 的**覆盖生效时机窗口** | 改基础算法只能依赖未文档化的时机 | | B2 | **agent-core** | 明确 `register_window_mutator` 在处理器链中的**执行点** | 窗口权威降级为尽力而为 | | B3 | JiuwenSwarm | 给出**可外部复用模块清单**并脱离 beta | `adapters/swarm/` 全部建立在内部模块上 | | B4 | JiuwenSwarm | **Skill Hub HTTP API 版本化**（现有 `hub_asset_port.py` 是 Python 端口稳定声明，HTTP 层无版本） | 被动跟随；最坏退回本地库 | | B5 | JiuwenSwarm | `skill_manager` 路径/config **改为注入式** | 见 A2 | | B6 | JiuwenSwarm | `common/config.py` 提供**无副作用导入模式** | 单进程形态下有静默 shadow 风险 | | B7 | JiuwenSwarm | jiuwenbox 发布到 PyPI | 便利性诉求，可用 git 子目录安装替代 | **B1、B2 最该优先推动**——「改基础算法」的能力完全取决于它们。 ### 6.5 反向：我们会不会侵入 JiuwenSwarm 不会，且是结构性的：单向依赖（`workswarm` 按 extra 引入、jiuwenbox 按本机服务引入），JiuwenSwarm 对我们零依赖；我们不跑它的进程、不实现它的协议、不改它的配置语义。若要贡献科学能力，走 Rail 插件 / Skill / MCP 的正向 PR，对它是加法。 --- ## 七、工作量 估算口径：同语言搬运约 800–1,500 行/人周；跨语言重写含测试约 250–400 行/人周；协议与语义对齐按耦合点计。不含产品需求变更与跨团队协同开销。**未做原型验证，第 0 阶段完成后需重新校准。** | 阶段 | 内容 | 乐观 | 可能 | 悲观 | |---|---|---:|---:|---:| | M0-a | 证伪 spike（四个判据，见第八节） | 2 | 3 | 5 | | M0-b | `sd-agent` 骨架 + `sd-api` 的 `agent-client` + 37 类事件映射 | 10 | 14 | 22 | | M0-c | 分层护栏、`ports/` 定稿、`adapters/native/` 兜底 | 3 | 4 | 6 | | M1-a | 工具面迁移 + 13,675 行域包加 HTTP 外壳 | 12 | 17 | 26 | | M1-b | 上下文三语义 + 证据门禁与评审检查点 | 6 | 9 | 15 | | M1-c | 科学探索 Provider（PUCT / idea-tree） | 8 | 12 | 20 | | M2-a~d | 按块接 JiuwenSwarm（Hub / Skill 包 / jiuwenbox / cron） | 15 | 22 | 36 | | M3-a | 分发：Python 运行时进单可执行文件 payload（双架构）、Docker | 8 | 11 | 17 | | M3-b | 测试与 CI：增 Python 层；E2E 大部保留（REST/SSE 与 Web 不变） | 6 | 9 | 14 | | **合计（M2 全接）** | | **70** | **101** | **161 人周** | | **不接任何 JiuwenSwarm 块** | | **55** | **79** | **125 人周** | **M2 各块彼此独立**，可以只接 Skill Hub 不接 jiuwenbox，或反过来。这是本方案与「整体二选一」的主要差别：**JiuwenSwarm 从一次性决策变成逐块定价**。 **不可逆点**：M1-a 完成后，工具实现不再留在 Node 侧。M0 全程可回滚。 --- ## 八、第 0 阶段的证伪判据 | # | 判据 | 决定什么 | |---|---|---| | ① | `create_deep_agent()` 跑通一次带工具调用 + 审批中断 + 流式的会话，并映射成现有 37 类 SSE | 自建装配的 4,000–8,000 行估算是否成立 | | ② | `register_window_mutator` 注入的受保护段，能否存活到最终 LLM 窗口（构造一个会被内置压缩器改写的长会话） | 上下文三语义能否等价迁移，还是要接受行为回退 | | ③ | 实现一个最小 `Provider` 并 `use_provider()`，验证 workflow 原语被整体替换后行为正确 | 科学探索能否成为多 agent 范式 | | ④ | `pip install workswarm` 后做依赖裁剪试验，量出可接受的最小依赖集 | M2 各块的分发成本 | 判据 ①③④ 直接决定路线，判据 ② 决定产品行为是否回退。**在第 0 阶段之前讨论总工期意义不大。** --- ## 九、待决定事项 1. **复用边界**：agent-core 直接依赖（本 issue）还是经 JiuwenSwarm Gateway（#84）。建议在 M0-a 一并验证后再定。 2. **是否采用 jiuwenbox**：采用则获得 Landlock、cgroup、推理隐私代理，但 **macOS 源码模式会失去沙箱**（jiuwenbox Linux-only）。需要产品明确。 3. **是否接 Skill 包管理**：涉及 6.2 的高 C 型侵入，三个选择需要拍板。 4. **控制面语言**：本方案保持 `services/api` 为 Node（保全约 81% 后端代码）。若未来要合并为单一 Python 后端，M0–M2 完成后可平滑过渡，但会额外触发 A3。 5. **差异化定位**：如果本项目的差异化主要在科学域能力（工具、连接器、证据溯源、科学环境、NPU），现有分层足够；如果在 agent 算法本身（上下文、探索、检索、演进），则应进一步收紧对 agent-core 的直接控制。这决定第 5 节各层级的使用频度。 --- ### 补充说明 - 本 issue 的全部结论来自上述基线 commit 的只读代码盘点，**未改动任何仓库**，未建分支、未提 PR。 - 归属用的「依赖率」是「模块内 import `openjiuwen` 的 `.py` 文件数 / 该模块 `.py` 文件总数」，是**代理指标**而非逻辑占比的精确度量；每条归属结论另有行数对照或具体文件路径佐证。 - C 型侵入的判定口径是「模块文件是否 import `jiuwenswarm.common.config` / `jiuwenswarm.common.utils`」，是传递依赖的一级近似；真正接入前应在 M0/M2 用一次真实 import 验证完整传递闭包。 - 与 #84 互为补充，不替代。

### 🚀 背景描述

Ascend 910B 上，主机 `npu-smi` 可以把每张卡都报成 Health OK，但同一张卡放进 bubblewrap 沙箱后经常打不开。原因是：进程进入 mount namespace 之后，昇腾驱动按调用者 `/dev` 里看得见的卡做枚举，而且是全有或全无——任意一张当时占不上的卡，会让整次 `drvGetDevNum` 失败（例如 `DRV_ERROR_RESOURCE_OCCUPIED`）。把宿主整个 `/dev` 绑进沙箱，在共享机器上几乎必然失败。

产品需要的结果是：操作员能从 Runner 状态看到卡的状态和占用，只勾选**能在沙箱里打开**的卡，勾选的卡绑进沙箱后编号从 0 开始，沙箱内能跑 `npu-smi info` 以及 MindSpore / torch-npu。本次只适配 910B。实现见合并请求 [#107](https://gitcode.com/openJiuwen/sciencediscovery/pull/107)。

### 设计思路

考虑过、并放弃的路：

- 把宿主 `/dev` 整棵绑进沙箱：驱动会一次看到所有卡，共享机上必挂。
- 用 `ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES` 做逻辑重映射：它作用在 CANN 运行时之上，挡不住驱动层枚举失败。
- 把作业改到宿主 NPU Broker（不进沙箱）：现有 Broker 继续服务白名单 workload，但不能冒充「沙箱内可用」。

选定做法：

1. **逐卡探针**。对每张卡起一个一次性沙箱，只 bind 这一张卡，在里面跑 `npu-smi info`。退出码 0 才标 `sandboxUsable`；失败时带上驱动原文。探针与正式 launch 使用同一套 namespace、`--cap-drop ALL`、全新 `--dev /dev`。
2. **勾选面**。Remote compute 里每个 Runner（含本机 `local`）列出全部卡：可用可勾，不可用禁用并给出原因。选择按 Runner id 持久化。保存时向该 Runner **现场要清单**，不读从未落盘的连接态。
3. **执行接线**。每次 Python / shell / 托管 shell 按目标 Runner 把已勾选卡号放进请求；Runner 启动前再校验。空勾选则请求里没有该字段，沙箱与无 NPU 时一致。
4. **绑定与编号**。保持 `--dev /dev`，对选中卡做 `--dev-bind /dev/davinci<host> /dev/davinci<sandbox>`，按 host 下标升序映射到 0..n-1。管理节点（`davinci_manager`、`devmm_svm`、`hisi_hdc`）按主机实际存在的绑定。有 NPU 时 PATH 才加上 `/usr/local/bin`，以便调用 `npu-smi`；无 NPU 时 PATH 不变。
5. **隔离不放宽**。仍是 `--unshare-all --unshare-user --cap-drop ALL` 与既有 seccomp。

共享机上「勾选时可用、稍后被占」是预期场景：启动时若卡已不可用，执行按卡号失败，而不是掉进框架深处。

### 涉及到的对外API

产品 HTTP（非公开 SDK 承诺，但是操作面用到的接口）：

- `GET /api/runners/npu`：本机清单 + 各 Runner 勾选。
- `PUT /api/runners/:runnerId/npu-devices`：保存勾选；含不可用卡时 409，并带驱动原因。
- 发给 Runner 的 Python / shell 执行请求增加可选字段 `npuDevices`（宿主卡号数组）。
- Runner `GET /resources`、`GET /npu/devices` 携带 NPU 清单。

未改 Host NPU Broker 的作业接口。

### 与其他模块的相关性描述

- 沙箱启动（bubblewrap argv、seccomp、能力丢弃）必须保持 fail-closed。
- Remote compute / 本机 Runner 卡片共用勾选控件。
- Provenance 把 `npuDevices` 原样 POST 给 Runner，不能在中间层丢掉。
- 执行签名窗口仍默认 30s；时钟差只能用 `SCIENCE_AGENT_EXECUTION_SIGNATURE_MAX_AGE_MS` 显式加宽。

### 测试设计与测试计划

- 单测：探针 argv、进程表误解析、勾选规则、从 0 重编号、无勾选时沙箱 `/dev` 无 davinci、有勾选时 bind 来自请求、四条执行路径带上 `npuDevices`、HMAC 默认 30s、PUT 现场问 Runner。
- 浏览器旅程 J7（mocked）：列出卡、不可用禁用、按 Runner 保存、重开保持、390px 无横向溢出。
- 910B 真机：勾选可用卡后产品 `run_shell` 在沙箱内 `npu-smi info` 成功；清空勾选后无 davinci、`npu-smi` 不在 PATH。
- 回归：既有 Host Broker 路径零改动。

### 其他信息

对应实现：[feat: 将 910B NPU 卡交给沙箱使用](https://gitcode.com/openJiuwen/sciencediscovery/pull/107)。

pr:114.body:
<!-- bot0-gitcode-native-export -->

Paired: [GitHub #114](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery/pull/114) ↔ [GitCode !167](https://gitcode.com/openJiuwen/sciencediscovery/merge_requests/167)

/kind feature

---

## 这个 PR 做了什么 / 为什么需要

把从 Git 仓库导入第三方 Skills 的三步手工流程（粘贴 URL → 扫描 → 创建 draft → 每个 draft 单独 publish，共 80+ 次点击 / 40 个 skill）改成一键流：一次扫描 + 一个确认按钮 + 单次原子 commit。

新加端点 `POST /api/skill-review-drafts/bulk-publish-git` 一次把 N 个 Git draft 打包成一个 SkillLibrary version；UI 上配套 Quick Import 开关、Presets 下拉（LRU 10）、确认 modal。

测试中修复了用户报告的问题：用 40-skill 仓库导入后搜索框看不到 — 根因是 bulk 端点之前只写 library 不写 managed catalog，把 library 变成"只写不读"。修复方案是 bulk commit 后同步到 managed，library 失败时自动回滚 managed；批量上限从 50 提到 200 以容纳 K-Dense-AI（90 个候选）等大仓库。

---

## 这个 PR 修复的 issue

无独立 issue — 用户在 Settings → Skills 页面实测发现。

---

## 测试计划与结果

**单元测试（pass/total）：**
- `packages/schema` 14/14：provenance.metadata 兼容老 payload + bulk 请求/响应形状稳定
- `services/api` 22/22 涉及 skills 的测试，其中 bulk-import 新增 4 个：happy path、filter 模式、library 失败回滚、managed sync 校验
- `services/api` 2/2 新 HTTP 测试：seeded drafts、404 idempotence、空批 / built-in 校验
- `apps/web` 813/813：bulk-import flow 端到端、presets LRU、ButtonSemantics 新 dialog-actions 行

**端到端（手动）：**
- 起服务后 `Settings → Skills → Import → Git repository`
- 粘贴 `https://github.com/google-deepmind/science-skills/tree/main/skills` → 扫描出 40 候选
- 打开 Quick Import 开关 → 候选清单折叠，显示 "Import 40 new from science-skills @ 68832757"
- 点击按钮 → modal 列出 40 个 checkbox（4 个 invalid 默认不勾选）+ "Cancel on conflict" 勾选框（默认 ON）
- 切换到 filter 取消 ON → Confirm → 36 个 skill 出现在 Project Skills library
- 搜索框输入 `academy-guide` → 命中、点击进入 Explorer

**真实大仓库验证（K-Dense-AI/scientific-agent-skills，90 个候选）：**
- 之前因上限 50 报错 `Select between 1 and 50` → 提升到 200 后顺利通过

**类型检查 / 构建：** 4 个受影响包（schema、specialist、web、api）clean

---

## 自检

+ - [ ] **设计**：方案已在 [plan](file:///home/zhy/.claude/plans/elegant-watching-clock.md) 记录，核心偏离（managed sync、bulk 限额）已在提交说明里交代
+ - [ ] **测试**：UT 覆盖新方法、新端点、新 UI 路径；新增测试随本 PR 一并上库
+ - [ ] **验证**：上文列出每层测试结果 + 端到端手动验证 + 真实大仓库（90 个候选）通过
+ - [ ] **接口**：新增 `POST /api/skill-review-drafts/bulk-publish-git`，新增 schema 类型 `BulkPublishGitSkillReviewDraftsRequest/Response/SkippedDraft`，均为 additive（`SkillVersionProvenance.metadata?` 也是 optional）
- - [ ] **文档**：未涉及官网文档修改

<!-- Special notes for reviewers -->

pr:129.body:
## Problem and behavior

Test entry points and discovery rules did not describe the same repository coverage. This change gives local development and CI one selector/runner, loads scenario metadata from adjacent `.case.yaml` files and module discovery from `.suite.yaml`, and preserves the existing test frameworks and default `pnpm test` scope.

Browser journeys move to `test/e2e/`, standalone API journeys to `test/st/api/`, and native agent smoke tests to `test/st/agent-runtime/`. Backend API and all contract scenarios are classified as ST; E2E is reserved for browser user journeys. Shared contract replay/normalization/comparison code lives once in `test/support/contract/`, with its UT alongside it; scenarios, baselines and accepted-difference policy live in `test/st/contract/`. Recursive Node/Web discovery, asset ownership checks and source/build mapping prevent silent omissions. Issue-number filenames are replaced with scenario/object names. Only two previously approved obsolete browser declarations are retired, with reasons and the remaining disabled-connector coverage gap recorded in the migration ledger.

## Directory and layer model

- Product UT stays in the owning module; test-tooling UT stays beside its implementation in `test/support/`.
- `test/st/agent-runtime/` covers direct cross-module agent collaboration.
- `test/st/api/` covers backend service chains through HTTP; `test/st/contract/` owns HTTP/event-stream scenarios and baselines. Both L1 and L2 contracts are ST.
- `test/e2e/` contains browser user journeys. There is no separate API E2E category.
- `test/support/contract/` supplies one shared contract implementation; no scenario-specific copies of the runner or normalizer are introduced.
- API IDs are `st.api.<scenario>` and all contract IDs are `st.contract.<scenario>`. `test/support/migration.json` records the moves and prior draft IDs. Browser IDs and PR/daily membership/backend matrices are unchanged.

## Scenario naming

Use lowercase kebab-case object/behavior names, without issue numbers, `journey-` / `-journey` or `l1-` / `l2-` labels. Examples:

- `test/e2e/first-run-onboarding.spec.ts` and `.case.yaml`, ID `e2e.browser.first-run-onboarding`.
- `test/st/api/child-workspace.mjs` and `.case.yaml`, ID `st.api.child-workspace`.
- `test/st/contract/cases/run-approval-denied.case.yaml`, scenario ID `run-approval-denied`, catalog ID `st.contract.run-approval-denied`.
- `session-multi-turn` describes the former `l2-two-turns` contract scenario; `run-events.json` holds run-event scenarios.

Implementation/config filenames and IDs stay aligned. Shared browser helpers are `scenario-fixtures.ts`, `scenario-report.ts` and `browser-fixture.ts`. Module UT follows module names; Python's conventional `test_*.py` discovery remains unchanged.

Step-report validation is now explicit in YAML (`reporting: steps`) rather than inferred from a `journey-` filename; all formerly marked journeys retain this enforcement. Naming validation rejects the historical test filename prefixes/suffixes.

`namingMigration` in `test/support/migration.json` records old/new paths, catalog IDs and contract scenario IDs. Baseline keys and accepted-difference case references are renamed together; expected response payloads, scenario steps and difference predicates are unchanged. External baselines using the old IDs need the same key migration. The naming migration preserved all 92 configured entries and their policies; the subsequent real-model extension below adds daily coverage, and all 88 retained browser test identities were verified after filename mapping.

## Triggers and usage

Install with `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, then:

```bash
pnpm test:list --profile pr --json
pnpm test:list --profile daily --json
pnpm test:doctor --case e2e.browser.first-run-onboarding --executor jiuwenswarm
pnpm test:pr
pnpm test:daily
pnpm test --case st.api.child-workspace --executor native
pnpm test --profile full --executor both
pnpm test:check
```

- PR opened/synchronize/reopened events run the configured PR policy. Pushes to `main`/`master` and manual CI dispatch use the same policy; existing binary/Docker gates remain.
- `test-daily.yml` schedules the daily policy at **00:17 UTC / 08:17 Asia/Shanghai**, with manual dispatch also declared. Scheduled execution starts when the workflow reaches the default branch.
- PR policy has **7 required entries**: both UT tiers, native deterministic ST, and four JiuwenSwarm browser scenarios. Daily policy has **82 required entries plus 54 observational contract entries** (27 scenarios × two executor labels). These are execution entries, not framework case counts.
- YAML separates `llm.mode`, supported executors and scheduled executors. Real-model/hardware/legacy gates are never enabled by selection. PR/daily executor policy cannot be overridden on the command line.
- Nonblocking entries retain FAIL/BLOCKED/etc. and produce `passed-with-observations` when required tasks pass. Full/manual selections treat every selected entry as required.
- GitHub provisions the browser stack/JiuwenSwarm dependencies; local callers must supply the prerequisites reported by `test:doctor`. CodeArts keeps its existing compatibility command scope.

See [test/README.md](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery/blob/refactor/configured-test-harness/test/README.md) for configuration examples, gates, executor limitations and report locations. Reports distinguish PASS, FAIL, BLOCKED, SKIPPED and NOT_RUN; external contract executor labels remain explicitly operator-declared.

## Configured subject models and assertions

Every case now explicitly declares `assertions.mode`: `deterministic`, `llm`, or `hybrid`. Real subject models are configured independently from judge models:

```yaml
llm:
  mode: real
  model:
    protocol: chat-completions
    baseUrlEnv: E2E_LLM_BASE_URL
    modelEnv: E2E_LLM_MODEL
    apiKeyEnv: E2E_LLM_TOKEN
assertions:
  mode: hybrid
  judge:
    model:
      protocol: chat-completions
      baseUrlEnv: E2E_JUDGE_BASE_URL
      modelEnv: E2E_JUDGE_MODEL
      apiKeyEnv: E2E_JUDGE_TOKEN
    timeoutSeconds: 60
    maxTokens: 1200
    maxInputCharacters: 24000
    rubric:
      - id: task-completion
        description: The answer and supplied artifact meet the requested task.
        threshold: 0.8
```

A model profile accepts exactly one literal `model` or `modelEnv`; each case may bind different environment names. Credentials are never stored in YAML. The initial transport is OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions; scoring requires a model supporting its temperature/max-token parameters.

Browser cases use `assessment.check(name, callback)` for configurable programmatic assertions and `assessment.submit({task, answer, artifacts, context})` for actual bounded evidence. Deterministic mode runs checks without a judge call. LLM-only mode skips those optional assertion callbacks. Hybrid mode requires at least one successful named check and all judge thresholds to pass. Ordinary framework `expect` calls remain mandatory structural/workflow guards. Never put setup/actions inside the optional assertion callback.

Judging runs only after the test body passes. Missing evidence, missing model configuration, malformed/missing/duplicate scores, low scores, HTTP errors and timeouts cannot produce PASS. There is no automatic fallback or retry. Every criterion has an explicit threshold in [0,1]. The configured input limit rejects oversized evidence rather than silently truncating it. Reports include per-attempt assessment attachments, resolved subject/judge identities, sanitized evidence, rubric, scores, reasons, usage when supplied and latency. A framework pass without required scoring evidence is rejected by the harness. Qualitative scoring does not prove numerical correctness; keep objective calculations checked programmatically.

The initial production example is `e2e.browser.model-request`: real subject + hybrid completion/delivery checks and report-quality scoring. The other two existing real-browser files retain deterministic assertions. All non-browser runners currently support deterministic assertions; unsupported scoring/runner combinations fail configuration validation explicitly.

## Daily real-model execution and setup

`test-daily.yml` invokes independent `external:none` and `external:real` jobs through the same reusable workflow. The external tag is derived from **either** a real subject or a live judge, so stub-subject/live-judge cases cannot accidentally enter the deterministic job. PR remains deterministic and receives no model secrets.

All three real-browser files run daily on both native and JiuwenSwarm as required work: six added entries. Daily now expands to **136 entries: 82 required and 54 observational contracts**. PR remains seven required entries. The real job explicitly sets `CI_ALLOW_REAL=1`; missing credentials cause required work to fail with unmet prerequisites.

Configure these repository Actions secrets for the supplied profiles:

- `E2E_LLM_BASE_URL`, `E2E_LLM_MODEL`, `E2E_LLM_TOKEN`.
- `E2E_JUDGE_BASE_URL`, `E2E_JUDGE_MODEL`, `E2E_JUDGE_TOKEN`.

Custom case-specific environment names must also be wired into the workflow. The implementation does not create secrets or choose a paid provider. Inspect with `pnpm test:list --profile daily --tag external:real --json`; with the six values exported and the isolated stack prerequisites ready, use `CI_ALLOW_REAL=1 pnpm test:daily --tag external:real`.

`literature-review` now registers/selects the configured model rather than hardcoded DeepSeek profiles; it still depends on its Skill/connector fixtures and PubMed availability. Those remaining requirements can block daily runs. Real-project Playwright traces are disabled because registration request bodies contain model keys; step screenshots and sanitized scoring evidence remain.

Local validation includes actual Playwright fixture execution against a local HTTP judge: three expected passes, three deliberate failures (native check, missing evidence, low score), three scoring requests and five assessment attachments. This verifies execution/reporting integration without calling an external model. No real-provider or complete product E2E pass is claimed: subject/judge variables were absent in the local environment during validation.

## Validation and limitations

Rebased onto `feat/jiuwenswarm` revision `9670568`, preserving its added tests, isolation changes and accepted contract differences.

- Catalog validation: **92 execution entries, 48 suites, 437 static assets**.
- Harness/contract tooling: **65 tests passed**; CI self-tests: **53 passed**; architecture: **19 passed** plus boundary validation.
- Documentation lint and links passed across 89 Markdown files.
- Pinned Playwright collection compared with the latest target: **90 upstream identities → 88 retained identities in 47 files**; exactly the two approved retirements explain the difference. This is collection, not test execution.
- Workflow YAML parsing, shell syntax and diff whitespace checks passed. Workspace-only guest packaging was checked for the YAML runtime dependency.

A full product E2E run and remote workflow execution have **not** been certified by these checks. Contract CI targets/baseline selection remain unprovisioned; their observations report BLOCKED until supplied. Existing product failures are not suppressed or fixed by this test-engineering change.

Implements #126. The issue remains the detailed scope and trigger/usage reference; merging into this feature branch does not activate default-branch scheduled runs.

pr:133.body:
This follows up on #123 (merged) with the next 51 commits of JiuwenSwarm backend integration work: prompt assembly order, tool exposure policy, task planning, approvals, skill setup, web search, trajectory recording, context compression, language sync, and sub-agent delegation.

## Prompt order
ScienceDiscovery's own product prompt comes first, JiuwenSwarm's full system prompt is kept intact and comes second, and the run contract comes last. New `SCIENCE_AGENT_JIUWENSWARM_PROMPT` switch (`replace` restores the old behavior). Adapter debug level 2 prints the full system prompt and tool list.

## Tool exposure
By default the model uses JiuwenSwarm's own tools, and ScienceDiscovery's tools are added only where JiuwenSwarm has no equivalent capability (`SCIENCE_AGENT_JIUWENSWARM_TOOLS=ours` switches back to the old full tool set). JiuwenSwarm's built-in host tools (bash, file read/write/edit, glob, grep, read_pdf) are hidden, with the equivalent capability going through ScienceDiscovery's sandboxed tools instead. Every tool for a run goes through one shared MCP server, named with a stable `mcp_sci_<tool>` scheme so JiuwenSwarm's permission policy can reference them. When names collide, each side's schema is kept without duplicate exposure.

## Task planning
The executor defaults to planning with JiuwenSwarm's own todo tool (`SCIENCE_AGENT_JIUWENSWARM_PLANNING=update_plan` switches back to the old approach); CI journeys still override with `update_plan`.

## Approvals
Approval questions are judged independently per resource instead of reusing an earlier approval for the same resource. Approval cards show the call the model-facing proxy actually saw (tool name plus the concrete command/arguments).

## Skill setup
The JiuwenSwarm backend reuses JiuwenSwarm's own skill mechanism, importing the run's skills into it; ScienceDiscovery's own skill directory and `read_skill` no longer apply under JiuwenSwarm. Skill toggles are managed from the settings page and apply to every session of the run.

## Web search
JiuwenSwarm's own web search (`free_search`) and page fetch (`fetch_webpage`) are on by default, driven by the web settings page (Bocha/Serper/Perplexity keys, backend selection); settings are pushed through the adapter's `config.set` and take effect after restart. Results from JiuwenSwarm's search/fetch are recorded into the memory graph the same way ScienceDiscovery's own search is (WebPage nodes plus body text in CAS).

## Trajectory
Adds a trajectory view for JiuwenSwarm runs, recording each model call's raw input/output, tool observations, and committed steps; sub-agents stay the `task` type but are tagged with their source.

## Context compression
The compression window is now a deployment-level setting (`JIUWENSWARM_CONTEXT_WINDOW_TOKENS`) instead of being configured per model. JiuwenSwarm's default model entry points at the adapter, and the adapter's own calls (including compression requests) are sent to whichever model the current run is using. The default model entry always sorts first in the model list, is written on startup, and is preserved when the list is trimmed (avoids JiuwenSwarm erroring on an empty model list).

## Language sync
Switching the UI language (zh/en) also sets JiuwenSwarm's `preferred_language`, including mid-session switches.

## Sub-agents
Sub-agent delegation now goes through JiuwenSwarm's own `subagent_spawn`/`subagent_wait`.

## CI
GitHub Actions' mocked E2E now runs against the JiuwenSwarm backend by default.

## Docs
Updated install/build guides, prompt ordering, tools/sandbox/approvals, skill setup, trajectory, and language sync documentation to match.

## Validation
Local `pnpm ci:ut` / `ci:st` / `ci:e2e` were not run for this PR — skipped at the operator's request so this PR could be opened directly and validated by remote CI (GitHub Actions) instead. Will update this description with local validation numbers if/when they're run.

pr:146.body:
## Follow-up update — 2026-09-23

This update adds the pending follow-up commits to the same personal-fork PR, rather than opening a duplicate PR. Target remains `feat/jiuwenswarm`; related #107 and #136. The validation in this section supersedes earlier local results below; historical real-model results are retained for context, not presented as validation of the latest head.

### Added scope

- Isolate shared MCP request cancellation/transport failures and add bounded, credential-conscious boundary/model-argument diagnostics. Consolidate the per-run deadline compatibility change into the version-pinned transport patch; verify patch installation is repeatable.
- Add configurable per-parent subagent concurrency (1–10, default 10) in system settings, with FIFO waiting, cancellation and lifetime-scoped permits. A deployment can set 2 without changing the product default.
- Wire real model transport/text/thinking/tool-argument progress to the owning run's idle watchdog. Preserve the hard whole-run deadline; sibling activity and unowned default-route housekeeping do not renew another run.
- Enforce child model-turn limits at request admission, before calling the provider, instead of inferring turns from UI events/tool-result counts. Keep the existing `timed_out` + `Subagent exceeded maxTurns=...` lifecycle contract. Exclude explicit housekeeping and the pinned Swarm compaction instruction; unknown future compaction prompts count conservatively as task calls. This prompt compatibility predicate is not a security boundary.
- Reject HTML/empty content masquerading as a PDF before publishing download completion. Check only a bounded 1 KiB header; full PDF parsing remains a separate extraction operation. Other artifact formats retain their behavior.
- Expand Mock literature coverage to source fallback, governed download/extraction, tool-output paging, real Swarm compaction, artifact isolation/reload, child budgets/cancellation and recovery. Add a provider-503 → cancel → healthy same-session/tool-backed run.
- Include the five stratified DeepResearchBench real cases and real custom Specialist/MCP/team signoff case, with opt-in record retention. Real evaluations remain manual and are not a PR gate.

### Latest verification

| Check | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Node Swarm agent/model gateway/download/subagent lifecycle regressions | 111 passed, 0 skipped |
| Python Adapter suite | 212 passed, 9 skipped: 7 opt-in live gateway scenarios and 2 real-LLM cases |
| Research model + literature-source fixture tests | 8 passed |
| Version-pinned Swarm/SDK compatibility and MCP boundary tests | 51 passed |
| FIFO subagent pool / UI settings draft tests | 3 passed / 1 passed |
| Actual Swarm + Mock LLM/source browser E2E | **20 passed, 0 skipped; 7.1 minutes; one worker** |
| Artifact manager and API builds | Passed |
| Documentation lint/links and CI catalog validation | Passed |

The 20 browser cases use the actual Swarm, Adapter, API, Runner and PDF extractor; only external model/source transports are scripted. They are not evidence of real-LLM research quality, a DRB score, or long-duration memory stability. The formerly failing LR-04 now proves the second child model request never reaches the model; LR-11 HTML now fails before completion.

Coverage details and reproduction prerequisites: `test/benchmarks/research-team/mock-coverage.md` and `jiuwen_swarm/README.md`. The existing research Mock gate remains enabled. **The complete new 20-case suite requires the dedicated offline-source fixture, exclusive Swarm instance and compaction configuration; it is not claimed to run in full in the default PR gate.** No real-provider credentials, raw private traces or local service configuration are committed. Latest CI results must be checked separately.

### Remaining boundaries

- A historical Swarm management-interface timeout was not reproduced by the new recovery case. Its initiating cause remains unproven; a passing controlled recovery test does not establish that the historical incident is fixed.
- No complete six-case real-LLM rerun or RACE/FACT quality score is claimed for this head. The interrupted DRB-59 run is not counted as successful.
- No new Swarm source patch was needed for the latest idle/model-turn/PDF fixes; the PR as a whole still includes the earlier version-pinned Swarm compatibility patches.
- This remains a source-checkout validation. Packaged binary/Docker compatibility, broader resource stability, and dashboard work remain outside these local results.

---

## Summary

Repair the Swarm-backed literature research path: specialist children receive their MCP tools, bind their own model connection, return explicit results/errors, and let the parent continue to a persisted report.

Targets `feat/jiuwenswarm` from the personal fork `zy95-12/sciencediscovery`. Related: #107, #136. Native Swarm delegation reuse remains a separate design discussion in #141.

## Changes and boundaries

- Retain **ScienceDiscovery `task` orchestration + Swarm execution** for main and child agents. When `subagents=task`, hide the native spawn/wait/list/send-input/close/resume tools from actual LLM requests, override generic native-delegation guidance, and reject stale native tool calls. Swarm search/fetch remain available.
- Bind a private model connection to each run/session using the real model name rather than per-run global model aliases/hot reloads. Forward bindings in stream/non-stream paths, allow idle-session rebinding, and reject active replacement. Preserve run/agent identity in credential-free lifecycle logs.
- Preserve startup and runtime errors, initial/resumed stream correlation and output ownership. Require an explicit terminal result: EOF/cancellation/failed status must not become successful completion.
- Keep MCP catalog refresh and child tool failures isolated; give the platform MCP transport a stable lifecycle owner and configured deadlines instead of competing wrappers/read timeouts. No automatic side-effect replay.
- Forward tool-call streaming progress, normalize model SSE output, and make child artifact handoff/provenance available to the parent.
- Carry six version-pinned, reviewable compatibility patches under `jiuwen_swarm/patches/workswarm0.2.6/`, plus regressions and setup/diagnostic documentation.
- Add/update a gate-enabled mocked research journey and an opt-in real DRB-59 browser journey, pinned upstream RACE/FACT evaluation support, and per-attempt result records. Research strategy, child count and source count are not prescribed by the benchmark prompt.

Merged the latest target branch and resolved the `scripts/jiuwenswarm.sh` conflict: source installs apply compatibility patches before virtualenv synchronization; the target branch's preinstalled path and instance initialization remain intact. The real validation below uses the source checkout, not packaged Docker/binary distributions; these distribution channels still need patch compatibility validation before claiming support for this run contract.

## Mock E2E is a PR gate; real E2E is manual only

`test/swarm-research-mocked.spec.ts` is included in the default mocked PR gate; the CI Swarm stack already enables its platform-task prerequisite. Only `test/deepresearchbench-swarm.spec.ts` is excluded unless **`E2E_RESEARCH=1`**. PR workflows do not set that variable. Real tests additionally require the real project and live credentials. Fast unit regressions also remain in normal CI.

Verified by test discovery: the default mocked list contains the Swarm research mock case and excludes the real case; explicit real opt-in discovers DRB-59. No scheduled benchmark/dashboard workflow was added.

Manual runs against an isolated, configured Swarm stack:

```bash
E2E_SWARM_TASK=1 npm --prefix .e2e run test:mocked -- swarm-research-mocked.spec.ts
E2E_RESEARCH=1 E2E_SWARM_TASK=1 E2E_DRB_EVALUATION=off npm --prefix .e2e run test:real -- deepresearchbench-swarm.spec.ts
```

See `jiuwen_swarm/README.md` and `test/benchmarks/deepresearchbench/README.md` for auth, generator/Judge configuration and full evaluation. Evaluation defaults to `full`; `off` is an explicit integration-only diagnostic mode, not a quality pass.

## Validation

### Latest real run — September 23

**GLM-5.2 + actual Swarm + browser: 1 passed.** Same DRB-59 bird-migration question as the preceding failed attempt. No fixed delegation count/search-depth prompt limits.

| Observation | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Actual delegation | Four platform `task` children; all completed |
| Child branches | Magnetic, celestial, olfactory/landmark, navigation disturbances |
| Recorded child turns | 9 / 25 / 16 / 15 |
| MCP activity | Successful PubMed / Europe PMC calls; child artifacts declared |
| Parent continuation | Continued research after child results and declared final report |
| Persisted report | `deepresearchbench-59.md`, 5,428 words, 30 headings, 50 distinct URL strings |
| Browser assertions | Visible artifact/preview, basic report structure, reload persistence and final handoff passed |
| Generation duration | 1,011,856 ms (~16.9 minutes) |
| Total browser test | ~23.8 minutes |
| RACE / FACT | Disabled for this run; **no quality score claimed** |

Browser validation was slowed by cgroup memory reclaim; the browser soft/hard limits were raised from 650/850 MiB to 1000/1100 MiB after checking host capacity. Assertions were unchanged; no OOM was observed. This affects timing comparisons. Raw traces remain private because they may contain credentials/research content; test services were stopped afterwards.

The earlier run failed because native subagent tools leaked into the task-mode toolset and native activity did not reset the platform idle timer. That failure is not hidden: the isolation fix addresses the task path; native-child progress forwarding remains outside this PR.

### Automated regressions

- After target-branch merge: API build, 86 affected Node tests, 190 adapter tests (9 skipped: 7 opt-in live Gateway scenarios and 2 real-LLM tests), 72 engineering/CI self-tests, documentation checks, shell syntax and compatibility patch reverse-applicability checks passed.
- Delegation isolation validation: 72 Node tests and 71 adapter tests passed.
- Earlier broader validation on this change series: 189 adapter tests passed / 9 skipped; 167 affected Node tests; 23 patched Swarm/SDK regressions; workspace typecheck, architecture boundaries, native hermetic ST smoke passed.
- Actual Swarm + mocked LLM browser journey: 1 passed (44.2 s), covering child error recovery, child artifact, parent reading it, final report/UI and follow-up session rebinding. This precedes the final isolation/config-only updates.
- Evaluator unit tests: 9 passed, 1 skipped, 9 subtests passed. The skip needs an external pinned evaluator checkout; it is not counted as passing.

This is not a full repository regression run. The real E2E pass precedes the subsequent target merge/manual-collection-only changes; it was not rerun after that merge. Latest CI still needs to run on this PR head.

## Known limitations / follow-up

- arXiv returned HTTP 406; one child mixed read_tool_output query/range arguments; another used a temporary file across shell calls. All recovered or continued in the passing run; upstream availability and these ergonomics are not claimed fixed.

pr:168.body:
This PR adds an opt-in, user-perspective JiuwenSwarm → `antibody-design` Skill → Ascend NPU journey, alongside the lower-level mocked NPU binding test. It depends on Skill backport PR #159; duplicate Skill PR #167 was closed.

## User journey

A fresh Project/Session is created with a live model and selected 131 Runner. The driver uploads the user's two PDBs and sends a high-level request through the public Session Runs API. It does not invoke any model script, choose a Python environment, or preseed model assets. The real Agent must load the Skill, inspect/select a managed environment, push inputs, perform first-use preparation and validation, run RFdiffusion → ProteinMPNN → Protenix → screening on NPU, pull results, declare report/CSV/CIF Artifacts, and explain the result. The test observes automatic wake Runs, committed execution receipts, nonempty remote and local stage files, completed transfers, and final Artifacts. It never resubmits an accepted user Run; a pipeline retry is accepted only after the preceding execution has a confirmed, committed failure. Any `unknown`/unconfirmed execution fails the test.

The real case is tagged `npu:required`, `model:real`, `status:external`, collected but deselected by ordinary PR CI until gated NPU hardware exists. The mocked binding/ST case remains for CI.

## Real-hardware verification (2026-09-24)

- **Full-Agent E2E: PASS (1/1)** on a fresh Project `9df41ef6-e2ea-4096-8e3a-6f8f5783e546`, Session `fb3dbdac-e218-40d5-a50c-565167421e4e`, initial user Run `a62cd447-a1e6-4570-8ddc-de3937edb97d`. The Agent loaded `antibody-design` itself, selected a managed environment, pushed inputs, and completed first-use preparation `74864a72-89e7-475d-af6e-ebf34495deaf` and validation with committed zero-exit receipts. One NPU pipeline Execution `a91eb590-1457-491a-977e-be73e98ba73c` finished `completed / committed / exitCode=0` on the selected remote Runner. RFdiffusion, ProteinMPNN, Protenix, and screening each produced files. Report, CSV, and CIF were transferred to the Session, declared as Artifacts, and explained by the Agent across the original and an automatic wake Run.
- The full live submission used the test driver at `9afed0fa`; the final `ae556055` driver passed by **read-only observation of the same Run**, after fixing a test-only assertion that had incorrectly required three `declare_artifact` tool calls even though the Agent legitimately declares multiple Artifacts in one call. No extra NPU job was submitted for that verification. The final Agent response also names the report, CSV, and CIF. The WSL product source snapshot was labelled `89a3ac7c` and included the Skill backport.
- Earlier fresh full-Agent Run `8d3814fa-f681-4957-a647-a55c81ac06e8` is **not a pass**: first-use preparation `4eb49ef9-8c60-4708-8996-9db8fec44500` became `unknown/unconfirmed` after `fetch failed`. A first pipeline attempt then had a confirmed Runner workspace-snapshot `ENOENT` on a transient MindScience `__pycache__` file; the Agent recovered and its later NPU pipeline/output delivery succeeded, but the preparation receipt remained unconfirmed. This is a real stability risk to address separately, not a result hidden by the passing rerun.
- The older prepared-environment NPU Run `c1ba1acc-2968-417f-8714-7947ee3e1b32` is lower-level evidence only, not the full-Agent E2E result.
- `node --check`, CI contract, E2E metadata (0 errors, 11 pre-existing legacy warnings), and diff whitespace checks passed locally. The previous CI run had ST, UT, Docker, both binary builds and CLA passing; the latest push starts a fresh CI run, so its final state is not yet claimed. The hardware case is intentionally deselected in CI.

## Release

User impact: no runtime code change; adds regression coverage for the complete Agent-to-NPU workflow.
Compatibility: merge Skill backport PR #159 before this PR.

pr:171.body:
Uncached arXiv searches in DRB-62 repeatedly returned HTTP 406, while long literature handoffs risked losing work at the end of a run. This PR changes the arXiv TLS handshake, encourages incremental artifact delivery, and adds diagnostics for research runs that stall or fail.

Changes:
- Enable `post_handshake_auth` on the certificate-verifying TLS context for arXiv searches only. Other biomedical sources retain their existing client settings.
- Suggest small batches of complete literature records, recoverable checkpoints, validation/deduplication and optional early versioned artifacts. Large child deliverables should use artifact references and concise final handoffs.
- Add opt-in arXiv HTTP diagnostics with status, timing, Retry-After, selected edge headers and a query hash; research text is not logged.
- Set DRB-58/59 generation budgets to 90/120 minutes, with separate per-case overrides and a separate evaluation budget.
- Add metadata-only active gateway request snapshots and idle/deadline diagnostics. Preserve current upstream streaming, model-turn admission, compaction classification and cancellation behavior.
- Surface malformed tool-argument failures with request identifiers, retain private argument diagnostics, and keep child timeout failures in child records instead of the lead assistant's message stream.

Merge order: **merge PR #184 first, then this PR after its checks pass**. This branch includes PR #184 head `a3dece01` and current `feat/jiuwenswarm`; after #184 merges, its benchmark files drop out of this PR's diff. PR #146 is no longer a prerequisite. PR #190's bounded output-limit recovery is separate and is not required by this PR.

Validation on the refreshed branch:
- 169 focused API/workspace tests passed.
- 14 biomedical gateway tests passed, including arXiv TLS and redacted HTTP diagnostics.
- Full workspace build and typecheck passed; 21 CI self-tests passed.
- Five targeted mocked Swarm E2E cases passed (LR-05/06 in both dispatch orders, plus LR-07 disconnect recovery), without skips or relaxed assertions. Remote CI is running on refreshed head `e74da43b`.
- Earlier live validation reproduced the original 406 and returned HTTP 200 for two recorded DRB-62 queries (15 and 10 records) and a fresh MCP query (five records). These live requests were not repeated during this branch refresh.

Limits: the observed 406 workaround is not a general fix for arXiv 429 or local queue timeouts. Logging is diagnostic, not rate-limit recovery. This PR does not claim to recover output-token exhaustion automatically; that behavior is developed in #190. Real research experiments using the skill/arXiv changes do not establish that all benchmark or quality checks pass.

This unnecessarily re-registered every tool and permission before the child reached its model, sometimes exhausting a 10-second task budget. Normalize equivalent union schemas, preserve the original model-facing constraints, and remove persisted permissions only when their MCP generation has no active users. Add metadata-only initialization timings and regression tests for generation reuse and permission isolation.

pr:187.body:
## Summary

Reduce false `unknown / unconfirmed` outcomes when an already accepted remote Shell Execution has a transient Runner status observation failure. This is a bounded mitigation for #185, not a claim that the underlying transport failure or post-`unknown` reconciliation has been solved.

## Changes

- Increase the wait between retries after transient Runner status-observation failures, with bounded backoff; keep querying the original Execution ID and never resubmit the accepted command.
- Reset the consecutive-failure count after any successful Runner status observation, including a still-running result.
- Mark the local execution `unknown / unconfirmed` only after **five consecutive** retryable status failures. Preserve the underlying error code in the recorded message when available. Identity mismatches and other non-retryable errors still fail immediately.
- Keep one concise, matching status-observation note in the English and Chinese `execution-workspaces.md` pages; no separate design page.
- Add regression tests for four failures followed by success, a success that resets the counter, and five consecutive failures without command replay.

## Validation

- WSL `pnpm build`: passed.
- WSL `node --import tsx --test src/shell-executions.test.ts` in `services/api`: 10/10 passed.
- `pnpm docs:check`: passed (0 lint issues; links checked across 87 Markdown files).
- One real Agent → antibody-design Skill → Ascend NPU workflow using this candidate completed the remote pipeline with committed provenance and delivered report, CSV, and CIF artifacts, with no `unknown` execution observed. PR #168's E2E assertion was corrected to match the natural-language request; a read-only resume of that same real Run passed 1/1. **This is one successful run, not statistical proof that transient failures have been eliminated.**
- Full WSL `pnpm test`: blocked in the existing binary-release suite because `services/runner/dist/sea/linux-x64/sciencediscovery-runner` is not provisioned (`ENOENT`; 28/29 binary tests passed). The command did not reach the recursive package tests. The user explicitly requested the PR despite this environment limitation.

## Follow-up

Issue #185 tracks the still-open root-cause investigation and Runner-authoritative reconciliation after the retry threshold, API restart, or Runner reconnection. This PR intentionally does not replay or recover an execution once it is already `unknown`.

pr:189.body:
When native `task` dispatch runs multiple Swarm children, every child's authority snapshot currently embeds the session-wide subagent catalog. Growing one sibling's tool transcript therefore inflates the other children's checkpoints. The child collector also receives the parent run ID, selecting the parent's execution provenance instead of its own.

This change gives snapshot collection an explicit session/execution/task scope. Children capture their own task, execution provenance, inbox, timers, shell executions and transfers. The native parent retains the task directory. Directory entries reference immutable `SubagentAuthority` records containing the complete task record and continuation-context reference; unchanged catalog objects reuse their reference. UI/task APIs retain their full records, and shared artifact versions, permissions and environment authorities remain captured. Historical records and closure integrity checks are preserved without a catalog migration.

In the regression fixture, adding 2.4 MB of sibling tool output leaves the other child's authority snapshot identical. The parent's two-entry task directory is 569 bytes, while both the old and new full task records remain readable by immutable reference.

Validation:
- API dependency build and API typecheck passed.
- 36 focused authority, notification, shell, transfer, continuation and native-versioning tests passed.
- 97 Swarm adapter, AgentRun and subagent-lifecycle tests passed.
- All 5 new tests executed under the PR profile: 5 passed, 0 skipped. They cover sibling-growth isolation, owner provenance/inbox, immutable revisions and cold reload, missing-reference rejection, cross-session rejection, and shell/transfer ownership.
- Architecture checks passed (53 script tests plus boundary validation); Markdown lint passed.

Based directly on upstream `feat/jiuwenswarm` at `60626de2`, which already includes #182. This does not depend on #146, #171, #183 or #184.

Scope: this is the state-isolation change. It does not optimize repeated historical closure traversal or every shared-resource snapshot, change timeout limits, or establish that DRB-59/DRB-75 now finish successfully. Real E2E benchmarks have not been rerun for this branch. English and Chinese architecture notes document these boundaries.

pr:190.body:
When a model exhausts its output budget, truncated tool arguments currently become a gateway failure, and reasoning-only responses end the task without an answer. Partial text can also be mistaken for a completed answer. This change keeps the task running for up to two recovery attempts, while preventing tools from the truncated response from executing.

The gateway withholds tool arguments until the response completes, preserves `finish_reason=length` and usage, and emits SSE comments while arguments are buffered. A per-instance Swarm model wrapper rejects truncated responses before argument repair or tool execution and asks the model to perform one small action or write a smaller batch. Recovery uses the existing model, context, turn admission, cancellation and deadlines; it does not replay completed operations or increase token limits. Exhaustion fails with diagnostics and preserves existing artifacts. Ordinary provider and transport failures remain separate.

Validation:
- 106 related API tests passed.
- 60 pinned Swarm boundary tests passed, including a real ReAct loop driven by controlled model responses: the truncated call never executes, the recovered call executes once, and the run completes.
- Full workspace typecheck and architecture checks passed.
- DRB-59 and TC-E2E-01 are running concurrently in an isolated experiment with memory graph disabled; real E2E outcomes are pending. DRB-59 uses RACE scoring; TC-E2E-01 retains its internal evaluator and contract checks.

This PR targets `feat/jiuwenswarm` independently. PR 171 skill/arXiv changes and real-experiment configuration are combined only in the separate experiment branch, not included here. Tool argument visibility is delayed until response completion; text and reasoning still stream. Bounded recovery is not a guarantee of task completion.

pr:191.body:
A subagent Resume action could fail with an internal server error after the user stopped its Session, because the global wake gate remained closed. Resuming a child now atomically reopens both the Session and child gates, allowing retained notices to be delivered without replaying stopped work.

## Validation
- Local automated UT/ST/mock E2E: not run at the operator's request; local validation is limited to browser testing.
- Static diff check: 0 whitespace errors.

## E2E user journeys
PASS — 1 manual Docker-backed browser journey / 1 passed / 0 failed. In a Session with a stopped completed subagent, clicked Resume subagent. The UI removed the resume controls without an error, and the actual resume endpoint returned HTTP 200. The historical child had already failed before context persistence, so no model turn was replayed; this preserves the intended no-replay behavior.

## Release
Release category: release:fix
User impact: Resuming a stopped subagent also restores its Session wake gate instead of failing with an internal server error.
Compatibility and migration: none.

pr:192.body:
A child repairing a report currently receives an Artifact reference but has no editable local copy. Paging the Artifact and reconstructing it through model-generated shell commands wastes time and risks truncated tool arguments or altered content. This change lets the child copy a fixed version into its isolated workspace, edit it with suitable tools, and publish an explicit revision of the original Artifact.

- Add `materialize_artifact(artifact_id, version, path)`: stream the original bytes from CAS through the existing workspace lock, checksum validation and atomic publication path. Return metadata only; reject different existing content and unsafe paths. Identical copies can be retried.
- Extend single-file `declare_artifact` with paired `artifact_id` and `base_version_id`. Preserve Artifact identity, immutable history, citation-chip mappings and base-version provenance. Reject stale bases, preserve local edits, and deduplicate replays using a persisted tool-call publication ID.
- Make the tools available to both the parent and native-task → Swarm children. Add short editing guidance and retain materialization receipts in durable Artifact context after compression.
- Preserve existing declarations and workspace isolation. Binary/generated files use their normal editing or generation tools; no text conversion, task dependency engine or shared writable parent directory is introduced.

Validation: workspace build and typecheck; 158 focused existing/new tests plus 2 durable-context tests; three real-stack mocked E2Es (AR-01, LR-13, LR-15) passed. AR-01 edits a large Unicode report in a Swarm child, checks exact original/revised bytes and proves the import result contains no report text. Service tests cover binary bytes, restart/replay, concurrent/stale publication, preserved local edits, traversal, symlinks, cross-project access and damaged CAS content. The frozen PR plan selects AR-01 as reviewed; no gate is weakened. CI catalog check passed.

DRB-64 has been launched separately with RACE scoring, memory graph disabled, the same 60-minute agent budget and a 24 GiB memory cap. Its result is pending; no claim of improved research efficiency yet. Catalog compare-and-update relies on the existing single-process SessionStore, not a new distributed transaction scheme.



The first CI run also exposed an existing J3 activity-disclosure regression: the trace shows a successful expand click followed about 65 ms later by a terminal refresh replacing the live card with a collapsed historical card. A separate commit preserves disclosure choices during that transition and records summary clicks synchronously before native toggle/remount. Existing J3 assertions and timeouts are unchanged. The added migration assertion failed before the fix; all 857 web tests, web typecheck/build and the complete J3 mocked journey pass locally after the fix. The latest remote CI run is pending.

pr:193.body:
## Problem and behavior
When a trajectory observer stalls, cancelling a Swarm run previously left the model gateway awaiting that observer. Once it eventually resolved, the gateway could still invoke the model client with an aborted signal. Final cleanup could also keep the cancelled run waiting for the recorder queue.

Make input/completion recording waits and final recorder draining cancellation-aware. Re-check cancellation before model dispatch. Already-started storage work remains serialized and drains/closes in its original queue; cancellation does not close storage mid-write. Normal runs still await recording and final cleanup.

## Diagnostics
Add payload-free `[recording-progress]` logs for queue waits, state/authority capture, workspace snapshots, context/step commits and final flushing. Operations pending for 30 seconds automatically log periodically without verbose tracing. Logs include operation/trajectory/request identifiers where available, elapsed time, cancellation and eventual completion/failure. Gateway diagnostics distinguish recording from upstream dispatch and response receipt. Developer documentation explains flags and limitations.

This fixes a confirmed cancellation defect, **not the unexplained historical multi-minute recording latency**. The new diagnostics are intended to identify that intermittent cause. Existing real E2E processes were not changed or restarted.

## Validation
- 123 related unit tests passed (gateway, Swarm agent, recorder/versioning, deadlines, new recording helper).
- Re-ran all 23 gateway tests after final dispatch guards: passed.
- API TypeScript build and test TypeScript checking passed.
- Replaced the gateway temporarily with the baseline implementation and ran the blocked-input regression without its new phase assertion: both streaming and non-streaming cases timed out after cancellation. Restored fix; both pass.
- Regression coverage includes late recording completion (no upstream dispatch), late rejection, cancelled final cleanup, and automatic slow-stage logs without research payloads.

pr:194.body:
## Problem
BiomniBench da-14-1 repeat 2 failed after three Swarm 60-second stream-idle timeouts while the model was actively generating tool arguments. At cancellation the gateway had received upstream data 2–9ms earlier and buffered 52–55KB of arguments.

The gateway correctly withheld incomplete tool arguments, but represented their progress as SSE comments. The OpenAI SDK discards those comments, so Swarm's decoded-chunk watchdog saw no progress and cancelled healthy generation.

## Change
Send a standard empty `delta` data event for each received tool-argument increment, through the existing downstream progress accounting. No partial arguments or synthetic assistant text are sent. Complete calls are released once at the finish boundary; truncated calls remain withheld. No timer-generated keepalive is introduced, so true upstream silence still times out.

Independent of PR #193 (recording cancellation), based directly on feat/jiuwenswarm.

## Validation
- 112 gateway/Swarm agent unit tests passed, including incremental-progress assertions before model completion and both complete/truncated argument cases.
- API TypeScript build and test TypeScript check passed.
- Actual gateway -> installed OpenAI SDK -> openJiuwen Model.stream parser/watchdog probe passed: a 1s argument stream survives a 0.5s idle budget, a complete call is emitted once, a truncated call never appears, and real upstream silence still times out.
- The identical full-client probe against the previous gateway fails with idle_chunk timeout despite continuous upstream increments (red/green verified).

Repeat the local integration probe with the Python environment used by Swarm (no paid model calls):
```bash
SWARM_PYTHON=/path/to/swarm/.venv/bin/python node --import tsx test/fixtures/swarm-tool-heartbeat-probe.mjs
```
The probe is optional, separate from the regular Node UT gate because it requires the Swarm Python installation. Existing real E2E processes were not modified or restarted.

pr:195.body:
Real research runs could deliver a report but fail Playwright because of fixed filenames, word/citation counts, workflow checks or quality thresholds. Separate completion from quality across all eight opt-in research cases.

- Completion requires a completed main run and a final response referencing a readable, nonempty persisted artifact. Intermediate outputs alone cannot pass; failed/cancelled runs with final outputs remain partial. Explicit version links are read immutably.
- Remove scientific/workflow quality assertions from completion. Preserve original research prompts, DRB RACE/FACT formulas and BiomniBench expert rubrics. Quality errors, missing inputs and low scores remain visible without failing delivery. Biomni rubric evaluation is enabled by default, with an explicit off mode.
- Add the versioned TC rubric: task coverage 20, evidence 25, analysis 25, reproducibility 15, collaboration/audit 15. A read-only Judge inspects frozen artifacts and retained trajectories. Code validates artifact/version identities and computes scores from 0–4 levels. Deterministic audit-text comparison is evidence for the Judge, not a new pass/fail gate.
- Retain raw Judge responses and bounded formatting recovery; truncated/invalid responses yield an error with no score. Existing evaluation directories cannot be reused. No additional automated Harness diagnostics layer.

Validation: delivery selection tests (3), immutable-content API tests (3), TC Judge tests (7, also invoked by a tagged UT wrapper), DRB evaluator/contract tests (16 passed, including the pinned upstream pipeline with mocked Judge/fetch and one correction), Biomni evaluator tests (3), targeted TypeScript checks, E2E metadata/catalog checks, Markdown lint and collection of all 8 real cases passed. Offline evidence loading against the three retained TC runs identified the known initial audit mismatch and later exact re-audits. No new paid research runs were started for this refactor.

Quality scores are independent assessments, not proof of correctness or delivery thresholds. DRB evaluation modes and coverage must still be reported separately; Biomni uses the existing local adapter to the official rubric.

RACE response reliability: add stable criterion IDs with the `race-criterion-id-v1` output-format appendix; preserve official rubric text, weights and upstream calculation. Validate IDs and scores before restoring canonical names. Allow one structure-correction call, reject changes to existing valid judgements, retain raw/normalized responses and specific validation errors, and prevent nested outer retries. The retained DRB-59 repeat-3 response is a regression fixture: old validation rejects its abbreviated name, while an explicit ID correction preserves all 26 judgements. No runtime fuzzy matching or historical score rewriting.

Executed failing phases now record `error`; configured FACT skips record `skipped` with a reason. Completed RACE scores remain visible if FACT fails. The output-format adapter version is recorded for comparisons. The additional tagged UT wrapper and catalog/Markdown checks passed.

pr:196.body:
Users who route through Requesty currently have to set it up as a custom OpenAI compatible provider by hand. This adds it as a built-in preset alongside OpenRouter, with the same shape: OpenAI chat completions, `GET /models` discovery, and a models.dev mapping for catalog facts and prices.

## Preset
`packages/schema/src/model-provider-presets.ts` gets a `requesty` entry right after OpenRouter: base URL `https://router.requesty.ai/v1`, `apiVariant: "openai"`, `modelDiscovery: "openai-models"`, docs `https://docs.requesty.ai`, key page `https://app.requesty.ai/api-keys`. `ModelProviderPresetId` in `model-provider.ts` gains `"requesty"`. The wizard and settings UI read the preset list, so nothing else changes there. Requesty is not made a default anywhere.

## models.dev mapping
models.dev publishes a `requesty` provider whose `api` is `https://router.requesty.ai/v1`, so the host check in `pricesApplyToPreset` accepts its prices for this preset. It is mapped after OpenRouter, in the aggregator block, so first publish wins still hands capability facts to the vendor listings. The ordering test in `packages/model/src/models-dev.test.ts` now counts `requesty` as an aggregator so a misplaced insert would fail it.

## How to test
Pick Requesty in the connect wizard, paste a key from https://app.requesty.ai/api-keys, and choose a listed model such as `openai/gpt-4o-mini` or `anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-5`. For EU routing, edit the base URL to `https://router.eu.requesty.ai/v1`.

## Validation
Run on macOS arm64 at ae150eb, with deps installed only for `@sciencediscovery/model` and its workspace dependencies.
- `pnpm typecheck` in `packages/schema` and `packages/model`: clean.
- `node scripts/check-architecture.mjs`: OK, 276 package source files checked.
- Package unit tests with `node --test "src/**/*.test.ts"`: schema 12 passed / 0 failed, model 45 passed / 0 failed (including "every aggregator mapping sits after every vendor mapping"). These files are tagged `os:linux`, so on macOS I ran them with `process.platform` reported as linux; nothing else was changed.
- Live check through the package's own code: `listProviderModels` with the preset's `baseUrl` and discovery strategy returned 762 models including `openai/gpt-4o-mini`, and `streamModelTurn` with the preset's protocol and variant streamed a reply from `openai/gpt-4o-mini` with usage reported.
- Not run: `pnpm ci:ut`, `pnpm ci:st`, `pnpm ci:e2e` and `apps/web` tests. The UT and E2E layers need a bubblewrap sandbox on Linux, which this macOS host does not have.

## E2E user journeys
BLOCKED on this host (no Linux sandbox for the local stack). The change adds one entry to a list the connect wizard already renders, and the live check above covers the provider's discovery and chat path. Happy to add or rerun a journey if you want one for this.

## Release
Release category: release:feature (label pending a maintainer, I cannot apply labels)
User impact: Requesty appears as a provider preset in the model connect wizard.
Compatibility and migration: none.

Disclosure: I work at Requesty. Happy to adjust anything to match project conventions.

The compression walkthrough assumed readers understood evolution terminology and did not explain how to interpret the reported score. Rewrite the Chinese and English tutorials as “使用PUCT优化一个文本压缩算法” / “Use PUCT to optimize a text compression algorithm” with eight sections: background, preparation, starting the task, requirements, optimization, results, caveats, and related documentation. Consolidate the two overlapping domain guides into evolve-a-solution.md in both languages, delete run-an-evolution-search.md, and update all incoming links and navigation titles.

The tutorial uses the retained real run (16 expansions, 4 workers; gate 0.5757 → 0.9540; held-out 0.9224) to explain the changes from Huffman to context-based range coding. It explicitly explains the generated evaluator’s normalization and clipping, so 0.9224 cannot be mistaken for 92.24% size reduction. It also documents observed checkpoint behavior and synthetic-corpus limitations.

Add a real PUCT-COMPRESS E2E that reads the tutorial prompt, chooses PUCT through the browser, acknowledges checkpoints when needed and waits for the background search. Completion requires a normally finished main/search run and readable persisted code matching the selected candidate. It accepts a seed that remained best and has no score/improvement/candidate-count threshold. Separately retain the final held-out score, baseline/best gate values and frozen evaluator; missing held-out scores remain unavailable with a note rather than becoming zero or being replaced by gate scores.

The case joins the existing daily real-E2E selection and stays outside mocked PR gates. A tagged UT covers score extraction, zero/no-improvement outcomes and unavailable scores. No existing case is disabled or reclassified.

Validation: project build, targeted E2E TypeScript check, 3 scorecard UTs, E2E metadata/catalog checks, real Playwright discovery, and Markdown lint and links across 100 documents passed. The new real E2E passed in 5m33s on an isolated Swarm stack (memory graph off, 24 GiB limit, two-hour budget). It retained a held-out score of 0.578559, with gate improving from 0.528571 to 0.644066. This run generated a different evaluator from the earlier exploratory run used in the tutorial, so their scores are not directly comparable.

CI follow-up: Docker dependency installation failed because the memory-graph lockfile pinned Tsinghua mirror URLs returning HTTP 403 for websockets 16.1.1. Normalize that lockfile to PyPI/pythonhosted URLs, preserving all 29 package versions and artifact hashes. A fresh no-cache Python 3.12 frozen install and a locked project install succeeded. Paired: [GitHub #77](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery/pull/77) ↔ [GitCode !154](https://gitcode.com/openJiuwen/sciencediscovery/merge_requests/154)

**What type of PR is this?**
/kind task

---

**What does this PR do / why do we need it**:

基于 `origin/main`（`425e4219`，已含 #137）从零实测 Docker Compose 部署：仓库自带 `Dockerfile` 冷构建、起栈、健康检查、浏览器登录、沙箱探针、同机多实例都能跑通，但新用户按现有文档会在几处卡住，文档也没有完整列出可配置的环境变量和常见问题。本 PR 把 Docker 部署指南重写成从构建到浏览器登录的完整步骤，补齐变量表与 FAQ，修一处 Compose 转发缺口，并把 Docker 分发路径纳入 GitHub Actions 守护。

1. **部署指南（中英同步）**：Docker 节改为「前置条件 → 准备配置与数据目录 → 构建 → 启动并确认健康 → 浏览器连接 → 配置模型」五步，之后是日常管理表、数据目录、多实例、环境变量、沙箱要求、常见问题（16 条）与限制。实测发现并写进文档的四个坑：bind mount 目录不先 `mkdir -p` 时 Docker 以 root 建目录，入口以「目录不可写」退出——多实例命令原来缺这一步，照抄必失败；日志里的登录链接端口固定是容器端口 4310，改了 `SCIENCE_AGENT_PUBLISH_PORT` 后要替换；首次启动会在后台创建 starter Python 环境（约 2 GB、需访问 conda-forge），不是卡住；镜像不含 evolve 与 memory-graph 边车，这两项功能在 Docker 中不可用。
2. **环境变量分层**：编排层只被 Compose 读取（`COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME`、`SCIENCE_AGENT_IMAGE`、`SCIENCE_AGENT_DATA_HOST_DIR`、`SCIENCE_AGENT_UID` / `GID`、`SCIENCE_AGENT_PUBLISH_HOST` / `PORT`），容器层经 `environment` 块逐个转发，镜像层由 `Dockerfile` 固定。配置参考的 Docker 表按此拆分并补齐；未转发的变量（如 `HTTP_PROXY`）说明用 `docker-compose.override.yml` 追加。
3. **Compose 转发缺口**：配置参考把 `SCIENCE_AGENT_USAGE_EXCHANGE_RATE*` 四个键和 `SCIENCE_AGENT_MICROMAMBA_BASE_URL` 列为 Docker 变量，但 `docker-compose.yml` 都没有转发，设了静默无效（与 #137 修的上下文变量同类）。四个汇率键改为转发并加入 `.env.docker.example`，空值等于内置默认（`config.ts` 的解析函数对空串返回默认值）；micromamba 镜像 URL 从 Docker 表删除——镜像已内置并播种固定版本，运行期不下载。
4. **deploy skill**：同步补上述坑与对应的排障行。
